title: ♪ Something Just Like TRuST ♪ *: Toxicity Recognition of Span and Target

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the performance (accuracy, precision, recall, F1) of toxicity detection and target group identification models across texts targeting different racial and ethnic groups (e.g., Black, White, Asian, Native American, Arab).
Benchmarking toxicity detection, target identification, and span detection models on texts directed at specific gender identities and sexual orientations (e.g., women, men, LGBTQ+).
Measuring variations in toxicity detection and target prediction performance across texts targeting different religious groups (e.g., Muslim, Jewish).
Evaluating model performance in detecting toxicity and targets in texts directed at specific nationalities, countries, regions (e.g., Middle East), immigrants, or refugees.
Assessing the predictive accuracy of language models on toxic text samples targeting individuals with disabilities.
Benchmarking toxicity detection models on texts targeting political figures or affiliations to measure performance disparities.
